# Learned instinct: supply-chain-verify-collection-checksums (confidence 0.9)

Ansible collections installed from Ansible Galaxy must be pinned to exact versions in `requirements.yml`. For production environments, additionally verify collection checksums using `ansible-galaxy collection verify` after installation. Collections from untrusted or unknown namespaces must be reviewed before use and approved via the change control process.

Source: SLSA supply chain; Ansible Galaxy security practices
